name: How can I prevent future damage to my window rough openings after repair?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future damage to my window rough openings after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future damage, ensure high-quality flashing and proper waterproofing membranes are installed around the window during repair or replacement. Regular maintenance is key: inspect window sealants annually and reapply as needed to prevent water intrusion. Keep gutters clean and ensure proper drainage away from your home's foundation to minimize moisture exposure to the walls around windows. Promptly address any signs of leaks or pest activity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure proper flashing and waterproofing during repair. Regularly inspect and reapply sealants, maintain gutters, and address leaks or pests promptly.
